name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.72-beta “Paris” (build 81): a steady preview in shared matters, and a clearer People & Connections.
• The preview stays still. In a shared matter, the preview went blank and was drawn again whenever the list refreshed, and Quick Look jumped back to page 1, because LitArbi took its own bookkeeping for a change to sync. Now a PDF keeps its page, zoom and position when the list refreshes, and so do text files, Word and Excel previews and an attachment shown in the preview. An edited file still reloads.
• People & Connections stays readable in large matters. People with one connection sit in a box under the person they are connected to, with one line for the whole box. The map fits the window, names take two lines, and long names no longer force the window wider. Click a card to light up its connections. In a small window, Connect and Remove Connection are no longer cut off.
Windows 10 (1809) or later, x64 or ARM64.
